# updateSheetNameInA1Notation

<link-summary>Replaces the sheet name in an A1 notation, keeping the range.</link-summary>

<web-summary>updateSheetNameInA1Notation() — Replaces the sheet name in an A1 notation, keeping the range. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.6.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function updateSheetNameInA1Notation(a1Notation: string, sheetName?: string | null): string;
```

What a formula rewrite needs after a sheet is renamed or copied. A name that needs quoting is quoted; a notation that had no sheet name gets one.

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Type             | Description               |
| :----------------------- | :--------------- | :------------------------ |
| `a1Notation`             | `string`         | The notation to rewrite.  |
| `sheetName` _(optional)_ | `string \| null` | The sheet name to put in. |

## Returns

`string` — the rewritten notation.

## Examples

### Renaming

```javascript
updateSheetNameInA1Notation("Sheet1!A1", "Data"); // => "Data!A1"
```
